title: Climbing Stairs
kidExplanation: Story version: To climb to the n-th stair, you have two options, 1. You can climb from the (n-1)-th stair. 2. You can climb from the (n-2)-th stair. So, the number of ways to reach the n-th stair is the sum of the number of ways to reach the (n-1)-th and (n-2)-th stairs. This forms a Fibonacci sequence where f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2). (We will slow down and draw it.)
